name: Canonical rich DOCX notes and inline pictures with existing partitioned translation

source.plain_compatibility: Original branch records, warnings, provenance and full encoded identity unchanged without actual body rich constructs; no old record migration.
source.notes: Exact canonical relationship/content type/part, unique normal ID↔body reference↔own first-paragraph label; independent note records retain part/kind/id/block locators after original body, first-reference order. No invented page or label/quote text. Ordinary preserved paragraph/run formatting is admitted in otherwise exact single-marker separators; the same global property-content refusal applies.
source.images: Only ordinary internal inline PNG/JPEG, exact relationship/blob/header/dimensions/hash and canonical DrawingML marker identity; original bytes untouched, no OCR/rendering.
source.text: Exact full original body+notes ReadingDocument and optional existing source_partition. Fixed pictures/note labels/references/bookmarks/proof markers and link boundaries delimit fragments; all nonblank source covered. Text/run/marker descendants inside preserved properties refused.
source.authority: Original source, approval, account, whole-text partitions, ledger receipts, resource broker, owned Windows process, cleanup and protected no-clobber export reused. One existing translation/2 job; no extra store/queue.
source.publication: Canonical replay proves exact expected text, unchanged locator/marker identity plus measured offset shifts, same image bytes and all unchanged ZIP members. Only main document and present note parts change. No postcommit callback.

No Word pagination, Office interoperability/visual quality, language quality or quotation approval
Only simple rectangular tables; floating/linked pictures, fields, tracked/hidden/custom text, complex structures, nontrivial separators, signed/macro packages refused
Headers and image alternatives remain unchanged and untranslated
Original plain notes/drawings rejection becomes a closed separate validated profile only, not a relaxed generic guard
